question: The chief priests were indignant when children shouted praise in the temple. What Scripture did Jesus quote in reply?
options: "Train up a child in the way he should go"
"From the lips of children and infants you, Lord, have called forth your praise"
"Let the little children come to me"
explanation: Matthew 21:16 says Jesus replied, "Have you never read, 'From the lips of children and infants you, Lord, have called forth your praise'?"
